A '''Daimanate flight commander''' was an officer in [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]'s starfighter corps during the [[Aquilaris campaign]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. During the final stages of the campaign, his [[Daimanate starfighter|starfighter]] was shot down by [[Kerra Holt]] who was flying a [[Fire Lotus-class starfighter|''Fire Lotus''-class starfighter]] she had borrowed from [[Jenn Devaad]]'s [[Devil Squadron]], a starfighter group within the pro-Republic [[Grace Command]]. Prior to his death, he communicated with Daiman and informed him of the Jedi attack on [[Aquilaris]], a province of [[Daimanate|Daiman's fiefdom]].
